QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] An Old Woman's Letter
QuestInfo.0: A crumpled, torn letter has arrived, and by the look of it, the sender was in a big hurry to send it. You should read the letter to see what was so important.
QuestInfo.1: It seems the letter is from an old woman living in Abrup. Perhaps a trek through El Nath Mountains is in order.
QuestInfo.2: After reading the hastily-prepared letter, it became clear that you should seek out its author in Abrup.
